identity.real_world_identity_notes: This is the Chevrolet Cruze-bodied entry in the 2023 Brazilian Stock Car Pro Series, not a road Chevrolet Cruze. The category used a common purpose-built Stock Car chassis and standardized platform components; the GM make annex identifies the Chevrolet Cruze body and construction for the 2023 edition.

The official CBA 2023 technical regulation establishes the category, year, purpose-built chassis, and make/model annex structure. The official 2023 GM annex specifically covers the Stock Car Chevrolet Cruze, and Chevrolet's own 2024 release identifies the competition Cruze as its racing version through the 2024 season.

claims.basis: The official CBA 2023 technical regulation establishes the category, year, purpose-built chassis, and make/model annex structure. The official 2023 GM annex specifically covers the Stock Car Chevrolet Cruze, and Chevrolet's own 2024 release identifies the competition Cruze as its racing version through the 2024 season.

The Article 13.2 gear-pair table assigns six forward gears to the permitted X-TRAC 396B023 transmission. Article 13.2 explicitly permits a semi-automatic paddle-shift actuation system. This supports the project's semi-automatic category, but does not establish internal dog-ring versus synchromesh construction. The regulation requires the semi-automatic paddle-shift actuation system. driver_summary: Stock car on a paddle semi-automatic: it cuts the upshift and blips the downshift for you. Whether it needs a clutch to pull away was not established by the drive, so treat the start as unrecorded rather than clutch-free.
